content: {"findings":[{"file":"index.js","line":208,"severity":"major","message":"The regex for stripWWW was changed from `[a-z.\\-\\d]{2,63}` to `[a-z.\\-\\d]{3,63}`, increasing the minimum TLD length from 2 to 3 characters.
